staffReports.title: Reports
staffReports.subtitle: Review user-submitted file and channel reports (oldest first).
staffReports.empty: No reports match the current filters.
staffReports.detailSubtitle: Inspect evidence, target status, and record a review decision.
staffReports.savedOnlyHint: The original file record is missing, but at least one saved copy still exists.
staffReports.removedHint: This target is no longer present in the database.
staffReports.enforcementNote: Updating report status only records your review. To moderate or remove the file or channel itself, open the target page.
staffReports.terminalHint: This report has reached a final state and can no longer be transitioned.

modals.inReviewDescription: Mark this report as currently under review. You may optionally attach a note (up to 2,000 characters).
modals.resolveDescription: Record a final resolution for this report. A decision note is required (1–2,000 characters).
modals.dismissDescription: Dismiss this report with no further action. A decision note is required (1–2,000 characters).

staffComplaints.title: Complaints
staffComplaints.subtitle: Review user complaints and manage localized complaint types.
staffComplaints.empty: No complaints match the current filters.
staffComplaints.detailSubtitle: Review submission details, attachments, and send an update.
staffComplaints.adminNotePlaceholder: Write an optional note or reply to the submitter…
staffComplaints.emailNoticeWithEmail: Heads up: saving a non-empty note when the status or note changes will send a reply email to {{email}}. Leave the note empty to update status without emailing again.
staffComplaints.emailNoticeNoEmail: No contact email is recorded on this complaint. Saving a note will update the record without sending an email.
staffComplaints.retireModalDescription: Retire "{{name}}"? Existing complaints stay linked to this type, and you can reactivate it at any time.

validation.namesRequired: Both English and Arabic names are required.
